Upper head is STRICT LEFT-FACING PROFILE: nose points to the LEFT edge, exactly ONE eye visible, a small brown moustache and otherwise clean jaw. Free viewer-LEFT hand rests at chest. This exact suit-specific direction and eye count is essential; override input 1's face direction.

Green substantial wool mantle with restrained red lining, plain oatmeal linen tunic, narrow woven cuff, practical bronze penannular brooch, simple bronze neck ring. MATCH input 1's entire ivory margin, gold/bronze Celtic interlace rectangular border on dark woad blue, red glass bosses, small corner triskeles, dark oak-leaf/acorn field, shaped cream portrait reserve, figure scale, and diagonal wool waist join. Use J and black spades pip in upper LEFT panel and its inverted partner lower RIGHT. No other suit or Q/K.
Two-ended court with the SAME new Jack rotated 180 degrees in the lower half. Same attribute repeats rotated. SMALL central bronze circular double-spiral medallion with TWO coils (not three), exactly at geometric card center, about 10 percent card width, paired small side triskel roundels on same waist axis. Weapon/leaf stays inside field without crossing the perimeter border or index panel. Clear hands and objects.
Detailed hand-painted ink/gouache of the SAME deck as input1, full card square-on. No horns, fur, antlers, runes, tartan, shamrocks, armor, glowing magic, druid costume, elf ears, medieval lavish hat or jewel crown. No tabletop, perspective, shadows, labels or additional words.
